description:
Fantom Corporation is a mission-focused organization supporting critical programs across the defense and intelligence community. We partner with our customers to deliver high-impact technical solutions while fostering a culture built on trust, expertise, and long-term career growth.
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to design and implement event-driven systems that improve observability and enable comprehensive event tracking across diverse data pipelines. This role develops modular, scalable solutions that accommodate new data formats and domains while supporting access control, fault tolerance, real-time alerting, and reliable digital record keeping.
You will use Python, Kafka, Grafana, and the ELK stack to build distributed applications, monitor system health, and support rapid responses to operational events.
Required Clearance Level: Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Design and implement event-driven architectures for tracking events across distributed data pipelines.



 
 Develop asynchronous and concurrent Python applications.



 
 Build and maintain Kafka integrations for distributed messaging and event processing.



 
 Develop modular components that support new data formats, integrations, and business domains.



 
 Implement fault-tolerant processing and recovery mechanisms to maintain reliable operations.



 
 Process and exchange structured data using JSON.



 
 Build observability capabilities that provide visibility into pipeline activity and system health.



 
 Create dashboards and monitoring solutions using Grafana and the ELK stack.



 
 Implement real-time alerting to support timely detection and investigation of system events.



 
 Incorporate access controls and maintain accurate digital records of system activity.



 
 Troubleshoot distributed processing, concurrency, messaging, and performance issues.



 
 Improve system scalability and adaptability as data infrastructure requirements evolve.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared TS/SCI with a polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 
 

 
 Proficiency in Python software development.



 
 Experience with asynchronous programming and concurrency.



 
 Experience using Kafka for distributed messaging and event processing.



 
 Strong understanding of distributed systems and event-driven design patterns.



 
 Experience working with JSON for data interchange.



 
 Experience implementing fault-tolerant architectures.



 
 Knowledge of observability practices for distributed applications and data pipelines.



 
 Experience using Grafana for dashboards and monitoring.



 
 Experience using the ELK stack for logging, search, and analysis.








Preferred Qualifications
 
 
 

 
 Experience implementing access controls in event-driven architectures.



 
 Expertise in modular system design for data pipelines.



 
 Familiarity with alerting and digital record-keeping solutions.



 
 Experience extending architectures to support multiple data domains and formats.








 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
